name: SSH_DISCONNECT_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_CONNECT
description: The remote host is not permitted to connect (e.g. TCP wrappers / firewall at the application layer)

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_ERROR
description: A malformed or out-of-sequence SSH protocol packet was received

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_KEY_EXCHANGE_FAILED
description: Key exchange failed (no compatible algorithm, or the exchange itself failed)

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_RESERVED
description: Reserved (also historically used for host authentication failure)

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE
description: The requested service is not available

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED
description: The peer's protocol version is not supported

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_HOST_KEY_NOT_VERIFIABLE
description: The host key could not be verified

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_CONNECTION_LOST
description: The connection was lost (network-level failure, not a clean protocol close)

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_BY_APPLICATION
description: The application (client or server) initiated a normal disconnect

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_TOO_MANY_CONNECTIONS
description: Too many concurrent connections from this source

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_NO_MORE_AUTH_METHODS_AVAILABLE
description: All configured authentication methods were exhausted without success

name: SSH_DISCONNECT_ILLEGAL_USER_NAME
description: The requested username is not permitted by the server
